**Checklist** (CONTRIBUTING.md says more about each)

- [ ] The subject reads `type(area): the change`
- [ ] Tests beside the change, and they fail without it
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes
- [ ] A change to a screen, a setting or a menu comes with its docs change
- [ ] I've read every line of this change, understand it and can answer questions about it, including any part a language model wrote
